welcome.heading: Find your next holiday, together
welcome.lead: Here's how it works. It takes about a minute to get going.

steps.title: DISCOVER AND ADD IDEAS
steps.text: Find places you'd love to go and put them on standby. Everyone in the family can add their own.

steps.title: DRAW AS A FAMILY
steps.text: Everyone spreads their points in secret, gets one veto, and the draw picks where you go.

steps.title: PLAN THE TRIP
steps.text: Your winner becomes your next departure, ready to plan together.

welcome.bonus: Log the holidays you've already been on to fill in your map.
welcome.note_organiser: First, two quick things: where you fly from, and one place you'd love to go.
welcome.note_member: First, one quick thing: a place you'd love to go.

airport.heading: Which airport do you fly from?
airport.lead: Pick the one closest to home. We use it to work out travel time to your ideas.
airport.label: Closest airport
airport.pass_note: You can change this any time in Settings.

idea.heading: Where would you love to go next?
idea.lead: Just one for now. Everyone can add more later.
idea.preview_note: This is how it'll look in your ideas.

done.heading: You're checked in
done.organiser_text: A draw needs a few ideas, so bring the rest of the family in.
done.member_text: Add more any time on Next, then draw together when everyone's ready.
done.invite_text: Send them this link. They don't need an email, they just pick their name and colour.
